title: Capability Definition
description: Schema for agent capability (skill) definitions in the manifest system.

description.description: Short description of when to use this capability.

paths.description: File path patterns that trigger this capability.

manual_only.description: If true, capability is only invoked manually.

user_visible.description: If true, capability is visible to the user.

references.description: Advisory paths to related documents. Not copied into the emitted skill folder; use bundle for physical inclusion.

scripts.description: Advisory workspace-relative paths to execution entrypoints. Not copied into the emitted skill folder; use bundle for physical inclusion.

bundle.description: Files to physically copy into the emitted skill folder ({skillsDir}/{id}/). Emitters rewrite matching workspace-relative paths in the skill body to dest (skill-root-relative). Distinct from references and scripts.

dest.description: Destination path relative to the skill root. Must not escape the skill directory (no .. or absolute paths).

tags.description: Selection tags for compile/deploy/update filtering. If omitted, the entity implicitly has the 'baseline' tag. Explicit tags replace the implicit baseline; include 'baseline' explicitly when needed. Empty arrays are forbidden.
